# Phantom

> Open-source workbench for running coding agents, coordinating a fleet, and reviewing their work. Mission: chasing open-source RSI (recursive self-improvement) as an agent-run software factory; agents follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. Copy the blocks below. Do not add flags that are not on this page. `phm docs --agent --json` from the installed binary wins if it disagrees with this file. A zero exit code is not a merge, a release, or permission to spend.

## Mission and roles

Phantom and its companion tools aim to form a fully autonomous, code-first, agent-native software factory. Agents pick work, open pull requests, merge them and ship releases through the repository's sanctioned workflow. The human owner acts as a passive board member: they set direction and are needed only for passwords, 2FA, device approvals and payments.

Kept limits stay with the owner or are refused: secret values, force-pushes and admin bypass, spending and billing, and messages to people outside the organization. A completed run, a merged PR and a published release are separate evidence; unknown readings stay unknown.

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before acting and the [strategy for recursive self-improvement and an open fleet](strategy/RECURSIVE-SELF-IMPROVEMENT-AND-OPEN-FLEET-2026-11.md) for direction.

## Install

Requires Node.js 22.15.0 or newer. `phm` and `ashlr` are the same program.

```sh
node --version
npm install -g @ashlr/phantom
phm --version
```

The source tree version is not proof that npm has published that version. Check [GitHub releases](https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/releases/latest) before you pin one.

## Commands that print JSON

These read local state. They do not start a fleet.

```sh
phm docs --agent --json
phm mcp list --json
phm mcp doctor --json
phm wire status --json
phm authority status --json
phm authority setup --dry-run --json
phm channels status --json
```

`phm mcp doctor` exits 1 when a required server is down. `phm authority status --json` reports the grant. Autonomy ships dormant and is macOS-only. Status does not turn it on.

## Console

```sh
phm verse --no-open --json
```

Serves http://127.0.0.1:7777/verse/ on loopback. The output includes a read token and a mutation token. Do not publish them.

## MCP: Claude Code

File: `~/.claude.json`, key `mcpServers`.

```sh
phm wire claude --json
```

Or paste:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ashlr-hub": {
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "ashlr",
      "args": ["mcp"],
      "env": {}
    }
  }
}
```

## MCP: Cursor

File: `~/.cursor/mcp.json`, key `mcpServers`.

```sh
phm wire cursor --json
```

Or paste:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ashlr-hub": {
      "command": "ashlr",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

## MCP: Codex

Do not hand-edit `~/.codex/config.toml`. `codex` must be on `PATH`.

```sh
phm wire codex --json
```

That runs `codex mcp add ashlr-hub -- ashlr mcp` after a backup.

## Check the wiring

Restart the editor, then:

```sh
phm wire status --json
phm mcp doctor --json
```

Registration does not prove the server started.

## Read-only fleet MCP

Separate from `ashlr-hub`. This server does not launch work or merge.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "phantom-fleet": {
      "command": "phm",
      "args": ["mcp", "fleet"]
    }
  }
}
```

Call `tools/list`, then `fleet_status` with `{}`. See [FLEET-MCP-ONRAMP.md](FLEET-MCP-ONRAMP.md).

## Ecosystem companions

Phantom is the hub. Each companion installs separately, from its own repository, and keeps its own authorization boundaries. Nothing below is bundled into `@ashlr/phantom`.

| Companion | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [phantom-secrets](https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom-secrets) | Local vault, placeholders and a proxy for supported API credential use. |
| [ashlr-plugin](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-plugin) | Compact tool results and a local usage ledger for coding agents. |
| [Locus](https://github.com/ashlrai/locus) | Account and tenant bindings for agent tools. |
| [lexicon](https://github.com/ashlrai/lexicon) | Corrects recurring speech-to-text errors before agents read them. |
| [ashlr-md](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md) | Markdown editing with CLI and MCP interfaces. |
| [ashlr-stack](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-stack) | Configures supported development services through CLI and MCP. |

Inspect what is installed (read-only; Secrets, Locus and Lexicon), then detect and grant integrations:

```sh
phm companions --json
phm onboard --ecosystem --json
phm mcp ecosystem --json
```

Install guides pinned to reviewed commits are in [COMPANIONS.md](COMPANIONS.md). The repository's `.mcp.json` declares `phantom-secrets`, `locus`, `lexicon`, `stack`, `context7` and `ashlr`; see [AGENT-TOOLCHAIN.md](AGENT-TOOLCHAIN.md) for limits and approvals.

## Watch the factory

```sh
phm org --text
phm improve propose --json
```

`phm org` prints the live leader, its planners, each lane and each running job; a fact no source reported is `null` in JSON and `unknown` in text. `phm improve propose` prints evidence-backed improvement proposals and does not open a PR unless you pass `--open-pr`.

## Work on Phantom from source

Agents build Phantom. To change this repository:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom.git
cd phantom
npm ci
npm run dev -- --help
```

Before a PR, run the changed-file check once in the foreground, then the documentation check and the affected tests:

```sh
node scripts/verify-changed.mjs
npm run check:docs
npx vitest run test/doc-facts.test.ts
```

Tests are hermetic: never touch the real home directory or real model endpoints. `src/cli/` handlers stay thin and logic lives in `src/core/`. Changing an exported signature means updating `CONTRACT.md` in the same change.

Outside contributors keep `ashlrai/phantom` as `origin`, push the branch to their own fork and open the pull request against `master`; `Merge Gate` is the one required check. [Contribute with an agent](CONTRIBUTE-WITH-AN-AGENT.md) walks through clone to auto-merge. Full conventions: [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), [AGENT-OPERATIONS.md](AGENT-OPERATIONS.md) and the repository's `CLAUDE.md`.

## Optional cloud handoff

```sh
phm cloud launch "<task>" --repo owner/name
phm devin connect
phm devin launch "<task>"
```

These do not merge by themselves. See [CLOUD.md](CLOUD.md) and [DEVIN.md](DEVIN.md).

## Fleet operation notes

### Route hysteresis

Dispatcher pool proposals keep a 60-minute residency; only auth failure or zero quota permits early movement. Launched jobs never move. At most two moves per six hours; blocked moves log `ROUTE_HOLD`. Read accepted trailing-hour moves:

```sh
phm route explain --json
```

See [ROUTE-HYSTERESIS.md](ROUTE-HYSTERESIS.md).

### Connector profiles

`phm connectors add|list|remove|show|import|exec|config --json` manages declarative connector metadata and Phantom Secrets references. `exec` launches with phantom-injected session tokens; `config` prints token-free client entries. See [CONNECTORS.md](CONNECTORS.md).

### Multi-Mac node pool

Configure explicit team SSH aliases, then join each Mac. Replace the placeholders with your own owner scope and aliases:

```sh
phm node pool --role primary --node <id> --owner <scope> --primary <alias> --backup <alias> --json
phm node join --owner <scope> --primary <alias> --backup <alias> --json
phm node watch --once --json
phm node list --owner <scope> --json
```

- Node ID defaults to the sanitized hostname. Repeating `phm node join --json` rechecks saved config without changing roles.
- RAM slots reserve max(4 GiB, 30%), then budget 4 GiB per job: 8 GiB gives one slot, 16 GiB gives two.
- Admission holds on available RAM below 30%, swap use, disk below 20 GB or unknown telemetry; pressure stops running work. Disk telemetry covers the home filesystem; the runner's DISKGUARD must cover checkout and artifact volumes.
- `phm node worker --runner /absolute/host-owned-runner --json` launches one bounded batch up to the RAM ceiling under one session, waits for every started slot and exits; there is no permanent supervisor.
- `phm node rpc --json` is the SSH stdin endpoint. The backup witnesses every admission and promotes after fifteen minutes; a returning primary is demoted.
- Share credential-free connector metadata and reviewed checkout MCP and skill files, never client auth. There is no automatic config synchronization, copied auth, new paid service, message send or worker publication.
- Lanes are independent per node; sharded inference has no measured win. iPad and phone are mobile control only.

See [AGENT-NETWORK.md](AGENT-NETWORK.md), [NODES.md](NODES.md) and `examples/node-pool/README.md`. Channel metadata, default-deny send policy and offline CLI examples are in [AGENT-NETWORK-CHANNELS.md](AGENT-NETWORK-CHANNELS.md).

### Small-Mac oMLX lanes

Enable with `~/.ashlr/local-lanes.json` containing `{"schemaVersion":1,"enabled":true}`, then:

```sh
phm node lanes --json
```

It prints the evidence-picked model, slots, backoff and suggested caps; `phm node join` and `phm node worker` advertise the `omlx`/`omlx-work` caps automatically. Hugging Face and oMLX weight caches under protected model roots are never deleted by disk maintenance by default. See [OMLX-SMALL-MACS.md](OMLX-SMALL-MACS.md).

### Tier-1 import diagnosis

```sh
npx tsx scripts/tier1-why.ts <file> --json
```

Prints a shortest runtime import chain from a Tier-1 root, or unreachable. `test/tier1-apps-boundary.test.ts` guards fleet apps isolation; do not regenerate the protected snapshot. See [TIER1-WHY.md](TIER1-WHY.md).
